name: merch-store
description: MERN merch store starter: auth with a 25 km Toronto geofence, Stripe payments, live delivery tracking on a map.

scripts.setup: node scripts/setup.js && npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c red,blue "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
